comments.content:
[medium] `p->stream_info.vflip` is a `bool` (see filters/filter.h), while the assigned value `vo->driver->caps & VO_CAP_VFLIP` is an integer bitmask. It will usually coerce fine, but normalizing with `!!(...)` is clearer and safer.

More importantly, `vo->driver` is dereferenced without a check. If `vo` can be non-NULL while `vo->driver` is NULL during init/teardown, this will crash. Guarding with `vo && vo->driver` (consistent with robust capability queries) would prevent that.

```suggestion
    p->stream_info.vflip = (vo && vo->driver) ? !!(vo->driver->caps & VO_CAP_VFLIP)
                                             : false;
```

[medium] Mutating a caller-owned `mpi` here is potentially unsafe: `mp_image_vflip(mpi)` changes the image in place, so if `mpi` is reused elsewhere (or shared via refcount), it can lead to surprising behavior or data races. On top of that, earlier in this function `layout.params.vflip` is already propagated into the per-plane `.flipped` flags, and flipping the image here may double-apply or conflict with that flag. Prefer keeping `mpi` immutable: either handle vflip purely via metadata/texture coords, or clone/copy the image before flipping (e.g., `mp_image_new_ref`/deep copy depending on semantics), and make sure only one vflip path is applied.
[low] Please confirm that `frame->current` is still correct after repeated updates to the surrounding state.
